rootCauses.deadConfirmButton: The previous correction replaced the live button onclick and called i272Sync with the broad page root rather than the same page object captured by the inherited i272Bind closure. In Edge this replacement could fail before opening the modal, while also bypassing the inherited functional path. The second correction no longer depends on a per-node stale onclick or pre-modal i272Sync call; it intercepts the final live [data-i272-confirm] click during capture, prevents the inherited modal from also opening, and opens the Index 275 modal exactly once from current canonical draft state.
rootCauses.missingAcknowledgments: The prior acknowledgment timer was scheduled around the pre-rerender action timing and could run before the post-transition workspace was stable. The second correction records a pending non-persistent acknowledgment from the inherited lifecycle modal confirm button, then repeatedly observes the newly rendered lifecycle state in enhance()/MutationObserver until the expected post-rerender state exists before inserting the role=status node into the active current-step workspace.

eventPathsRepaired.materialAccountabilityConfirm: document capture click -> live [data-i272-confirm] -> preventDefault/stopImmediatePropagation -> openIndex275AccountabilityModal() -> Cancel removes modal or Confirm calls existing i272Confirm().
